parts:
Hi all,

I'm also trying to replicate the code from pp. 86 from the book with a
different data but I'm getting an error message about "alpha", which I
don't really understand:

> mort + geom_rect(aes(NULL,NULL,xmin=start,xmax=end,fill=democracy),
+ ymin=yrng[1],ymax=yrng[2],data=brazil) +
+ scale_fill_manual(values=alpha(c("red","blue"),0.2))
Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_manual.

In addition I am getting a totally non-sense graph. I searched over
both the book and the web but I don't really got where alpha was
defined.

Many thanks!

Antonio.

>
> I'm also trying to replicate the code from pp. 86 from the book with a
> different data but I'm getting an error message about "alpha", which I
> don't really understand:
>
>> mort + geom_rect(aes(NULL,NULL,xmin=start,xmax=end,fill=democracy),
> + ymin=yrng[1],ymax=yrng[2],data=brazil) +
> + scale_fill_manual(values=alpha(c("red","blue"),0.2))
> Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_manual.

The error message isn't about the alpha call. scale_fill_manual is a
discrete scale but a continuous variable (democracy, in your example)
was mapped to it. That is the error. Is democracy numeric (continuous)
or a factor or character (discrete)?
> In addition I am getting a totally non-sense graph.

Can't help with that because your example is not reproducible (I don't
have mort, brazil, and yrng) and I don't really know what you are going for.

> I searched over
> both the book and the web but I don't really got where alpha was
> defined.

The index points to page 73.

> Many thanks!

> Antonio.
